evals.prompt: Write a bash script using curl that creates a free-form procedure named 'Refund requests' on ElevenLabs agent agent_abc123, branch agtbranch_xyz789, and then publishes it. Do not run the script.
evals.expected_output: Bash script that POSTs a free-form procedure and then publishes the branch
expectations: POSTs to a URL matching /v1/convai/agents/{agent_id}/branches/{branch_id}/procedures with agent_abc123 and agtbranch_xyz789
Sends the xi-api-key header populated from the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable, never a literal key
Sends a JSON body containing name, type set to free_form, trigger, and content
Captures procedure_id from the create response before using it later
Publishes with a PATCH to /v1/convai/agents/agent_abc123 with branch_id as a query parameter

evals.prompt: Using the ElevenLabs REST API and curl, show me how to add a structured (deterministic) procedure to agent agent_abc123 on branch agtbranch_xyz789 and get it live. Do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: Curl commands covering structured validation, compile, and publish
expectations: Uses type 'deterministic' with the procedure content passed as a JSON-encoded string
Calls the validate-structured-procedure endpoint or explains validating before saving
POSTs to the procedures/compile endpoint before publishing
Checks the compile response for errors and does not publish when errors are present
Sends the compiled workflow in the PATCH body to /v1/convai/agents/agent_abc123 along with branch_id

evals.prompt: I created a procedure on my ElevenLabs agent a minute ago, but GET /v1/convai/agents/{agent_id}/branches/{branch_id}/procedures/{procedure_id} returns 404. Explain why and show me the curl call that reads what I actually have.
evals.expected_output: Explanation of draft versus branch HEAD reads, plus the draft endpoint call
expectations: Explains that the plain procedure endpoint reads branch HEAD and a newly created procedure is still an unpublished draft
Shows a GET against the /draft suffix of the procedure endpoint
Mentions that publishing the branch through the agent update endpoint makes the branch HEAD read succeed
Does not suggest retrying the create call to fix the 404
